register.labelZh: FASTEN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: FASTEN 片語動詞可以描述某人的目光或注意力集中在一個人或事物上的情況。；fasten on、fasten onto 和 fasten upon 可以描述牙齒、上下顎、爪子或手指緊緊抓住某物。；fasten the blame on somebody 可以幫助你說明某個問題或錯誤的責任被歸咎於誰。；fasten up 可以用來叫人把外套、連身裙、袋子或類似物件扣好或關好。
register.summaryEn: FASTEN expressions can describe the moment when someone’s eyes or attention settle on one person or thing. Fasten on, fasten onto and fasten upon can describe teeth, jaws, claws or fingers holding something tightly. Fasten the blame on somebody helps you explain who is being held responsible for a problem or mistake. Fasten up can be used when telling someone to close a coat, dress, bag or similar item securely.
